title: Senior Renewable Energy Consultant
description:
**Senior Renewable Energy Consultant**

Residential Solar, Battery Storage & Energy Management

Forecast Energy | Hybrid Remote | Washington State

Estimated Annual Commission Earnings: $75,000–$150,000

**About Forecast Energy**

Forecast Energy has served the Pacific Northwest since 2005 under the same ownership, with a focus on renewable energy since 2012. We design and install solar PV, battery storage, microgrids, EV charging infrastructure, and integrated energy management systems throughout Washington State.

Our work extends well beyond traditional rooftop solar. We help homeowners reduce utility costs, prepare for outages, and gain greater control over their energy through thoughtfully designed systems, including whole-home backup, off-grid power, ground-mounted arrays, and complex electrical integrations.

We are not a high-pressure sales organization. Our approach is rooted in technical analysis, customer education, and long-term problem solving. We strive to provide our customers with the best possible value by keeping overhead and project costs competitive without compromising the quality of our work.

Our experienced in-house design, electrical, and installation teams allow us to deliver thoughtfully designed, reliable energy systems at a fair price. We believe every part of the project, from design and equipment selection to installation and sales, should contribute to that value. Our goal isn't simply to offer the lowest contract price, but to deliver the best overall value for our customers' investment.

**About the Role**

We're seeking an experienced Senior Renewable Energy Consultant who understands residential solar and battery storage and enjoys helping customers make informed decisions about their energy needs.

You'll independently evaluate customer goals, analyze utility and site information, develop technically sound proposals, and guide projects from consultation through contracting and installation.
